Apple___Apple_scab.description: Velvety olive-green to dull black spots appear on leaves and fruit. Leaves turn yellow and drop early, leaving trees bare and fruit cracked with rough corky patches. Common in wet, humid highland orchards during cool rainy spells.
cultural_controls: Collect and burn or bury fallen leaves in late autumn to destroy overwintering fungal spores.
Prune dense tree canopies during winter rest to let sunlight penetrate and speed up leaf drying.
Keep the soil basin under the tree canopy weed-free; avoid splashing water on lower trunks.
chemical_controls: Blue Copper Powder / நீல மருந்து - Blitox 50 or Fytolan [Chemical: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP]: Greenish-blue protective powder. Mix 3 tablespoons (45-50g) in a 15-liter knapsack pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 45-50 கிராம்). Spray at green tip stage before flowering.

Yellow Powder Fungicide / மஞ்சள் பொடி மருந்து - Dithane M-45 [Chemical: Mancozeb 75% WP]: Widely available yellow powder. Mix 2 tablespoons (35-40g) per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 35-40 கிராம்) from pink bud to petal fall.

Curative Liquid / கருகல் நிவாரண திரவம் - Score 25% EC [Chemical: Difenoconazole 25% EC]: Concentrated liquid medicine. Take 6-8 ml per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 6-8 மி.லி) for rapid healing within 72 hours of rain.
Powdery Mildew Curative / சாம்பல் நோய் திரவம் - Contaf Plus [Chemical: Hexaconazole 5% EC]: Take 15 ml per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 15 மி.லி) as an economical systemic spray.
biological_controls: Panchagavya Organic Spray / பஞ்சகாவ்யா இயற்கை உரம்: Mix 450 ml per 15-liter pump (3% solution) to strengthen natural leaf immunity against fungal infections.
Sulfur Dust Powder / கந்தகப் பொடி மருந்து - Sulfex 80% WDG [Chemical: Wettable Sulfur]: Mix 35-40 grams per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 35-40 கிராம்) during sunny weather.
Trichoderma viride Bio-Fungicide / உயிர் பூஞ்சாணக் கொல்லி: Mix 60-75 grams per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 75 கிராம்) at petal fall.
preventive_measures: Plant scab-resistant apple varieties in new orchard blocks.
Disinfect pruning shears with Dettol or spirit when moving from tree to tree.
Monitor orchard weather alerts and apply protective spray before continuous rainy periods.

severity_actions.Mild: Pick off early spotted leaves and spray protective Yellow Powder Fungicide - Dithane M-45 (35-40g per 15L pump).
severity_actions.Moderate: Spray systemic curative Score 25% EC (6-8 ml per 15L pump) or Contaf Plus (15 ml per 15L pump); ensure full canopy drenching.
severity_actions.Severe: Initiate strict fungicide rotation every 8-10 days alternating Score and Dodine; prune infected spurs and burn fallen leaves.

fertilizers_and_nutrition: All 19 Foliar Tonic / 19:19:19 ஆல் 19 இலைவழி உரம்: Mix 75 grams in a 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 75 கிராம்). Spray foliage every 12-15 days to rebuild vigorous green growth.
Pre-Bloom Micronutrients / நுண்ணூட்டச் சத்து கரைசல்: Spray Chelated Zinc (30g) + Borax (15g) per 15-liter pump to improve fruit set and leaf strength.
Fruit Development Spray (Potassium Nitrate 13:0:45): Mix 60 grams per 15-liter pump during fruit sizing for high disease resistance and fruit color.
Tree Basin Dressing / மட்கிய தொழு உரம்: Apply 25-30 kg well-rotted farmyard manure (மட்கிய தொழு உரம்) + 2 kg Vermicompost (மண்புழு உரம்) per tree basin.

Apple___Black_rot.description: Small purple specks enlarge into circular spots with brown centers resembling 'frog eyes'. Causes dark sunken cankers on limbs and black leathery rot on ripening fruits. Spreads rapidly in warm, rainy weather.
cultural_controls: Prune out dead wood, fire-blighted twigs, and shriveled fruit mummies during winter rest.
Cut away branch cankers cleanly 4 to 6 inches below visible infected bark.
Paint pruning cuts larger than 1 inch with Bordeaux paste (போர்டோ பசை).
chemical_controls: Blue Copper Powder / நீல மருந்து - Blitox 50 [Chemical: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP]: Mix 3 tablespoons (45g) in a 15-liter knapsack pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 45 கிராம்) at bud swell.

Yellow Powder Fungicide / மஞ்சள் பொடி மருந்து - Dithane M-45 [Chemical: Mancozeb 75% WP]: Mix 35-40 grams per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 35-40 கிராம்) from petal fall through fruit sizing.
Systemic White Powder - Roko [Chemical: Thiophanate-methyl 70% WP]: Mix 15 grams per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 15 கிராம்) for deep systemic canker healing.
biological_controls: Trichoderma Paste / ட்ரைக்கோடெர்மா பசை: Apply fresh Trichoderma paste directly onto scraped bark cankers.
Pseudomonas Bio-agent / சூடோமோனாஸ் கரைசல்: Mix 75 grams per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 75 கிராம்) on foliage during active flush.
Panchagavya Organic Spray / பஞ்சகாவ்யா கரைசல்: Mix 450 ml per 15-liter pump (3% solution) to strengthen tree vitality.
preventive_measures: Avoid wounding tree bark with tractor equipment or pruning ladders.
Maintain balanced tree nutrition; avoid excessive chemical nitrogen; apply recommended potassium.

severity_actions.Mild: Prune out dead twigs, collect fallen infected leaves, and spray Blue Copper Powder - Blitox 50 (45g per 15L pump).
severity_actions.Moderate: Apply systemic Roko (15g per 15L pump) or Yellow Powder Fungicide (35g per 15L pump); coat open bark cuts with Bordeaux paste.
severity_actions.Severe: Chop and burn severely cankered branches; execute systemic fungicide rotation program and drench tree basin.

fertilizers_and_nutrition: All 19 Foliar Tonic / 19:19:19 ஆல் 19 இலைவழி உரம்: Mix 75 grams in a 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 75 கிராம்) every 14 days.
Micronutrient Tonic / நுண்ணூட்டச் சத்து கரைசல்: Spray Chelated Zinc (30g) + Boron (15g) per 15-liter pump.
Organic Soil Booster / மட்கிய தொழு உரம்: Apply 25-30 kg farmyard manure (தொழு உரம்) + 2 kg Vermicompost per tree.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.description: Bright orange-yellow circular spots form on the upper leaf surface in spring. Tiny raised pustules develop on the underside, discharging powdery rust spores. Can defoliate trees if left untreated.
cultural_controls: Inspect surrounding borders and remove wild cedar or juniper host shrubs within 500 meters of the orchard.
Prune out swollen galls on nearby junipers before spring rains.
Ensure good orchard spacing and canopy pruning to allow fast foliage drying.
chemical_controls: Yellow Powder Fungicide / மஞ்சள் பொடி மருந்து - Dithane M-45 [Chemical: Mancozeb 75% WP]: Mix 35-40 grams in a 15-liter knapsack pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 35-40 கிராம்). Spray from tight cluster stage to petal fall.
Curative Liquid / கருகல் நிவாரண திரவம் - Score 25% EC [Chemical: Difenoconazole 25% EC]: Take 6-8 ml per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 6-8 மி.லி) for active rust eradication.
Powdery Mildew & Rust Curative - Contaf Plus [Chemical: Hexaconazole 5% EC]: Mix 15 ml per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 15 மி.லி).
biological_controls: Sulfur Dust Powder / கந்தகப் பொடி மருந்து - Sulfex 80% WDG [Chemical: Wettable Sulfur]: Mix 35 grams per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 35 கிராம்).
Neem Oil Spray / வேப்பெண்ணெய் கரைசல்: Mix 45 ml neem oil + 5 ml soap water in a 15-liter pump.
Panchagavya Organic Spray / பஞ்சகாவ்யா: Mix 450 ml per 15-liter pump.
preventive_measures: Plant rust-resistant apple varieties.
Start protective sprays early in spring when orange cedar galls first swell during rain.

severity_actions.Mild: Spray protective Yellow Powder Fungicide - Dithane M-45 (35-40g per 15L pump) at first orange speck.
severity_actions.Moderate: Spray systemic curative Score 25% EC (6-8 ml per 15L pump); ensure full foliage coverage.
severity_actions.Severe: Spray Score or Contaf Plus every 10 days until rust sporulation ceases.

fertilizers_and_nutrition: All 19 Foliar Tonic / 19:19:19 ஆல் 19 இலைவழி உரம்: Mix 75 grams in a 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 75 கிராம்).
Potassium Booster (SOP 0:0:50): Mix 60 grams per 15-liter pump to enhance leaf cuticle thickness.
Basin Manure: Apply 20 kg farmyard manure (தொழு உரம்) around the root zone.

Apple___healthy.description: Foliage is dark green, robust, and showing healthy active spur growth with zero disease lesions.
cultural_controls: Maintain clean tree basins free of aggressive weeds and standing water.
Prune excess water shoots to optimize sunlight penetration across the canopy.
Apply clean organic mulch around tree basins to retain steady root moisture.
chemical_controls: No chemical fungicides or pesticides required. Maintain routine seasonal monitoring.
biological_controls: Panchagavya Organic Spray / பஞ்சகாவ்யா இயற்கை உரம்: Mix 450 ml per 15-liter pump (3% solution) monthly to sustain plant vigor.
Neem Oil Preventive / வேப்பெண்ணெய் கரைசல்: Mix 35 ml neem oil with soap water per 15-liter pump during pest season.
preventive_measures: Inspect leaves and spurs weekly during wet spring and monsoon flushes.
Ensure orchard irrigation drains well and does not waterlog tree root collars.

severity_actions.Healthy: No chemical treatment needed. Continue balanced organic feeding and seasonal pruning.

fertilizers_and_nutrition: All 19 Foliar Tonic / 19:19:19 ஆல் 19 இலைவழி உரம்: Mix 75 grams in a 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 75 கிராம்) every 2 weeks.
Micronutrient Tonic / நுண்ணூட்டச் சத்து கரைசல்: Spray Chelated Zinc (30g) + Borax (15g) per 15-liter pump at pink bud.
Root Basin Dressing / மட்கிய தொழு உரம்: Apply 25-30 kg well-rotted farmyard manure (தொழு உரம்) + 2 kg Vermicompost (மண்புழு உரம்).

Blueberry___healthy.description: Canopy is vigorous with glossy green leaves and strong vegetative shoot extension.
cultural_controls: Maintain acidic soil pH (4.5 to 5.2) using pine bark or peat moss mulch.
Use drip irrigation to deliver uniform moisture without wetting foliage.
Hand-pull weeds gently to protect shallow feeder roots.
chemical_controls: No chemical intervention needed. Monitor for leaf spot during rainy weather.
biological_controls: Panchagavya Organic Spray / பஞ்சகாவ்யா: Mix 300 ml per 15-liter pump monthly.
Trichoderma Soil Drench / ட்ரைக்கோடெர்மா: Drench 50 grams per 15L pump around root zones twice yearly.
preventive_measures: Ensure good drainage; avoid high-salinity or alkaline canal water.
Prune weak, twiggy old canes annually in late winter.

severity_actions.Healthy: Maintain acid soil mulch and light foliar nutrition.

fertilizers_and_nutrition: Ammonium Sulfate Acidic Tonic: Apply 20 grams per bush in split doses.
All 19 Foliar Tonic / 19:19:19 ஆல் 19 உரம்: Mix 50 grams per 15-liter pump monthly.

Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.description: White talcum powder-like fungal coating develops on young leaves and terminal shoots. Leaves curl upward, become brittle, and drop prematurely, stunting branch growth.
cultural_controls: Prune infected shoot tips (*தலை கிள்ளுதல்*) and burn them away from the orchard.
Thin interior shoots to improve air circulation and direct sunlight penetration.
Avoid excessive chemical nitrogen fertilizers that produce overly succulent, vulnerable shoots.
chemical_controls: Powdery Mildew Curative / சாம்பல் நோய் திரவம் - Contaf Plus [Chemical: Hexaconazole 5% EC]: Mix 15 ml in a 15-liter knapsack pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 15 மி.லி). Spray thoroughly over shoot tips.
Curative Liquid / கருகல் நிவாரண திரவம் - Score 25% EC [Chemical: Difenoconazole 25% EC]: Take 8-10 ml per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 8-10 மி.லி) at petal fall.
Sulfur Dust Powder / கந்தகப் பொடி மருந்து - Sulfex 80% WDG [Chemical: Wettable Sulfur]: Mix 35 grams per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 35 கிராம்) during warm sunny spells.
biological_controls: Sour Buttermilk & Asafoetida Spray / புளித்த மோர் மற்றும் பெருங்காயக் கரைசல்: Mix 750 ml sour buttermilk + 10g hing in a 15-liter pump. Natural lactic acid suppresses mildew spores.
Neem Oil Spray / வேப்பெண்ணெய் கரைசல்: Mix 40 ml neem oil + 5 ml liquid soap per 15-liter pump.
Panchagavya Organic Spray / பஞ்சகாவ்யா: Mix 450 ml per 15-liter pump.
preventive_measures: Begin preventive sprays right after petal fall when new leaves start growing.
Do not use sprinkler overhead irrigation; keep tree foliage dry.

severity_actions.Mild: Prune curled shoot tips and spray Sulfur Dust Powder - Sulfex (35g per 15L pump) or sour buttermilk.
severity_actions.Moderate: Spray systemic Contaf Plus (15 ml per 15L pump) or Score (8-10 ml per 15L pump); ensure complete canopy coverage.
severity_actions.Severe: Repeat systemic fungicide spray every 10-12 days until white powdery mildew completely dries up.

fertilizers_and_nutrition: All 19 Foliar Tonic / 19:19:19 ஆல் 19 இலைவழி உரம்: Mix 75 grams in a 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 75 கிராம்).
Potassium Nitrate (13:0:45): Mix 60 grams per 15-liter pump to strengthen leaf cell walls.
Organic Manure / மட்கிய தொழு உரம்: Apply 20 kg farmyard manure + 2 kg Vermicompost per tree basin.

Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.description: Foliage is clean, vibrant green, and actively growing without powdery mildew or leaf spot symptoms.
cultural_controls: Prune competing inner branches during winter to maintain open vase shape.
Apply organic mulch around the tree drip line to keep root zone cool.
Ensure clean drip irrigation without pooling around the trunk base.
chemical_controls: No chemical intervention needed. Monitor regularly during rainy periods.
biological_controls: Panchagavya Organic Spray / பஞ்சகாவ்யா இயற்கை உரம்: Mix 450 ml per 15-liter pump monthly.
Neem Oil Preventive / வேப்பெண்ணெய் கரைசல்: Mix 35 ml neem oil with soap water per 15-liter pump.
preventive_measures: Inspect young shoot flushes weekly in spring.
Ensure orchard drainage paths are free and clear.

severity_actions.Healthy: Continue regular balanced organic nutrition and seasonal pruning.

fertilizers_and_nutrition: All 19 Foliar Tonic / 19:19:19 ஆல் 19 உரம்: Mix 75 grams per 15-liter pump monthly.
Basin Dressing / தொழு உரம்: Apply 20 kg farmyard manure per tree annually.

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.description: Narrow rectangular, tan-to-gray lesions form parallel between leaf veins. Lesions coalesce into large blighted areas, drying out the upper canopy and reducing ear grain filling.
cultural_controls: Deeply plow under corn crop residues after harvest to bury fungal spores in soil.
Practice 2-year crop rotation with legumes (groundnut, soybean, or cowpea).
Avoid excessive planting density to allow good air movement between rows.
chemical_controls: Blue Packet Combo Fungicide / சாஃப் மருந்து - SAAF [Chemical: Carbendazim 12% + Mancozeb 63% WP]: Popular blue packet. Mix 2 tablespoons (30g) in a 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 30 கிராம்).
Ear & Foliage Curative - Tilt 25% EC [Chemical: Propiconazole 25% EC]: Mix 15 ml in a 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 15 மி.லி) at tasseling stage.
Yellow Powder Fungicide / மஞ்சள் பொடி மருந்து - Dithane M-45 [Chemical: Mancozeb 75% WP]: Mix 35-40 grams per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 35-40 கிராம்).
biological_controls: Panchagavya Organic Spray / பஞ்சகாவ்யா இயற்கை உரம்: Mix 450 ml per 15-liter pump (3% solution) to stimulate plant vigor.
Pseudomonas Bio-Fungicide / சூடோமோனாஸ்: Mix 75 grams per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 75 கிராம்).
Neem Oil Spray / வேப்பெண்ணெய்: Mix 40 ml neem oil with soap water per 15-liter pump.
preventive_measures: Plant certified gray leaf spot-tolerant hybrid maize seeds.
Ensure balanced potash fertilization to strengthen maize stalks and leaf tissue.

severity_actions.Mild: Spray Blue Packet Combo Fungicide - SAAF (30g per 15L pump) on lower affected leaves.
severity_actions.Moderate: Apply systemic Tilt 25% EC (15 ml per 15L pump); spray before tasseling to safeguard the ear leaf.
severity_actions.Severe: Repeat systemic fungicide spray within 10 days to protect ear filling.

fertilizers_and_nutrition: All 19 Foliar Tonic / 19:19:19 ஆல் 19 இலைவழி உரம்: Mix 75 grams in a 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 75 கிராம்) at knee-high stage.
Potassium Booster (MOP): Apply 25 kg Muriate of Potash per acre to improve disease resistance.
Micronutrient Tonic (Zinc Sulfate): Foliar spray 30g Zinc Sulfate per 15L pump to prevent white bud chlorosis.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.description: Small, powdery cinnamon-brown to golden-brown pustules erupt on both upper and lower leaf surfaces. Ruptured pustules discharge dusty rust spores when rubbed.
cultural_controls: Plant early in the season to avoid late-season cool, humid weather favorable to rust.
Eradicate wild oxalis weeds along field bunds that act as intermediate rust hosts.
Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation during late afternoon.
chemical_controls: Yellow Powder Fungicide / மஞ்சள் பொடி மருந்து - Dithane M-45 [Chemical: Mancozeb 75% WP]: Mix 2 tablespoons (35-40g) per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 35-40 கிராம்) at first pustule sight.
Systemic Rust Curative - Tilt 25% EC [Chemical: Propiconazole 25% EC]: Mix 15 ml in a 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 15 மி.லி).
Curative Liquid / கருகல் நிவாரண திரவம் - Score 25% EC [Chemical: Difenoconazole]: Take 8-10 ml per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 8-10 மி.லி).
biological_controls: Sulfur Dust Powder / கந்தகப் பொடி மருந்து - Sulfex 80% WDG [Chemical: Wettable Sulfur]: Mix 35 grams per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 35 கிராம்).
Panchagavya Organic Spray / பஞ்சகாவ்யா இயற்கை உரம்: Mix 450 ml per 15-liter pump.
Neem Oil Spray / வேப்பெண்ணெய் கரைசல்: Mix 40 ml neem oil with soap water per 15-liter pump.
preventive_measures: Sow certified rust-resistant maize hybrids.
Apply balanced nitrogen and potassium; avoid excess nitrogen alone.

severity_actions.Mild: Spray Yellow Powder Fungicide - Dithane M-45 (35-40g per 15L pump) at first appearance of brown pustules.
severity_actions.Moderate: Spray systemic Tilt 25% EC (15 ml per 15L pump) to protect the top canopy leaves.
severity_actions.Severe: Repeat systemic fungicide rotation within 10-12 days if pustules spread up to the ear leaf.

fertilizers_and_nutrition: All 19 Foliar Tonic / 19:19:19 ஆல் 19 இலைவழி உரம்: Mix 75 grams in a 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 75 கிராம்).
Potash Application: Side-dress 20 kg Potash per acre to strengthen leaf cell walls.
Zinc Micronutrient: Foliar spray 30g Zinc Sulfate per 15L pump.

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.description: Large, elongated cigar-shaped grayish-green to tan lesions (1 to 6 inches long) develop on leaves. Lesions merge during wet weather, scorching the entire leaf and sharply decreasing grain yields.
cultural_controls: Plow down crop residues after harvest to bury fungal inoculum.
Rotate corn with non-grass crops (groundnut, soybean, or green gram) for at least 1 year.
Avoid dense planting; maintain 60 cm x 20 cm spacing to improve airflow.
chemical_controls: Yellow Powder Fungicide / மஞ்சள் பொடி மருந்து - Dithane M-45 [Chemical: Mancozeb 75% WP]: Mix 2 tablespoons (35-40g) in a 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 35-40 கிராம்).

cultural_controls: Maintain weed-free rows during first 35 days using mechanical weeding.
Earth up soil around stalk bases at knee-high stage to prevent lodging.
Provide critical irrigation at tasseling and silking stages.

biological_controls: Panchagavya Organic Spray / பஞ்சகாவ்யா: Mix 450 ml per 15-liter pump at 30 and 45 days.
Neem Oil Preventive / வேப்பெண்ணெய்: Mix 40 ml neem oil with soap water per 15-liter pump.

Grape___Black_rot.description: Small reddish-brown circular spots appear on leaves with tiny black spore pimples. Berries turn brown, shrivel up into hard black wrinkled mummies, and stay attached to the bunch.
cultural_controls: Prune and destroy all dried mummified berry bunches and diseased canes during winter pruning.
Maintain open vine canopies through shoot thinning and leaf pulling around fruit clusters.
Keep vineyard floor free of tall weeds that trap morning humidity.

Disinfect pruning secateurs with alcohol between vine rows.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).description: Leaves develop striking 'tiger-stripe' patterns of yellow/white chlorosis and brown necrosis between green veins. Dark purple-brown spots ('black measles') speckle berry skins, and mature vines suffer sudden summer apoplexy (wilting).
cultural_controls: Prune vines strictly during late winter dry periods to minimize spore entry through cuts.
Seal all pruning wounds larger than 1.5 cm immediately with Bordeaux paste (போர்டோ பசை).
Cut back chronically affected cordons several inches below visible wood discoloration.

biological_controls: Trichoderma Wound Dressing / ட்ரைக்கோடெர்மா பூசுதல்: Apply fresh Trichoderma viride paste onto fresh pruning cuts within 24 hours.

Panchagavya Organic Spray / பஞ்சகாவ்யா: Mix 450 ml per 15-liter pump.
preventive_measures: Source certified disease-free vine rootstocks from authorized nurseries.
Avoid severe pruning cuts that expose extensive heartwood.

severity_actions.Mild: Paint all pruning cuts with Bordeaux paste and spray Blue Copper Powder (45g per 15L pump).
severity_actions.Moderate: Prune out dying arms below dark internal wood staining; drench trunk base with systemic Roko (20g per 15L pump).
severity_actions.Severe: Uproot and burn collapsed vines; disinfect the planting pit with lime and Trichoderma before replanting.

cultural_controls: Collect and burn all fallen leaves after harvest to eliminate overwintering spore reservoirs.
Prune dense vine canopies to promote swift leaf drying after monsoon showers.
Maintain weed-free vine basins to reduce under-canopy humidity.

biological_controls: Bordeaux Mixture 1% / போர்டோ கலவை: Dissolve 150g Copper Sulfate + 150g Slaked Lime in 15 liters of water.
Panchagavya Organic Spray / பஞ்சகாவ்யா இயற்கை உரம்: Mix 450 ml per 15-liter pump (3% solution).

Grape___healthy.description: Vines are strong with vibrant green foliage, robust shoot canes, and clean bunch clusters.

Regulate drip irrigation to match berry development phases.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).pathogen_type: Bacterial (Candidatus Liberibacter asiaticus, spread by Asian Citrus Psyllid)
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).description: Blotchy, asymmetrical yellow mottling appears across leaf veins. Leaves become small, upright, and leathery with zinc-deficiency-like patterns. Twigs die back, and fruits stay small, lopsided, sour, and green at the base.
cultural_controls: Inspect trees regularly; immediately cut down and burn severely declining trees to protect surrounding orchards.
Eradicate wild jasmine and orange jessamine (*Murraya paniculata*) shrubs nearby that host the psyllid insect vector.
Control ground ant colonies that protect psyllid nymphs from natural predators.

biological_controls: Neem Oil Vector Spray / வேப்பெண்ணெய் கரைசல்: Mix 45 ml neem oil (10,000 ppm) + 5 ml soap water per 15-liter pump.

Pseudomonas Soil Drench / சூடோமோனாஸ்: Mix 100 grams per 15-liter pump around tree root zone.
preventive_measures: Plant only certified disease-free grafted saplings from government-certified nurseries.
Establish yellow sticky traps across the orchard to monitor citrus psyllid flights.

severity_actions.Mild: Control psyllid insect vectors with Confidor (5-7 ml per 15L pump); spray micronutrient cocktail.
severity_actions.Moderate: Spray Streptocycline (6g per 15L pump) + Blue Copper (35g per 15L pump); prune dead shoot twigs.
severity_actions.Severe: Mark and uproot unproductive, severely declining trees; burn stumps and control psyllids on remaining blocks.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.description: Small angular water-soaked purple-brown spots form along leaf midribs. The necrotic centers drop out, leaving a distinct 'shot-hole' appearance. Can cause severe fruit pitting and gum-oozing bark cankers.

biological_controls: Pseudomonas Bio-Fungicide / சூடோமோனாஸ்: Mix 75 grams per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 75 கிராம்).

severity_actions.Moderate: Apply Plant Antibiotic Packet - Streptocycline (6g per 15L pump) mixed with Blue Copper (30g per 15L pump).

Zinc & Boron Spray: 25g Chelated Zinc + 15g Borax per 15-liter pump.

Stake bell pepper plants upright with bamboo sticks (*மூங்கில் கம்பு கட்டுதல்*) to prevent soil contact.

Copper Hydroxide Spray - Kocide 2000 [Chemical: Copper Hydroxide 53.8% DF]: Mix 25 grams per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 25 கிராம்).
biological_controls: Sour Buttermilk & Asafoetida Spray / புளித்த மோர் மற்றும் பெருங்காயக் கரைசல்: Mix 750 ml sour buttermilk + 10g hing per 15-liter pump. Natural lactic acid creates an antibacterial leaf shield.
Neem Oil Spray / வேப்பெண்ணெய் கரைசல்: Mix 40 ml neem oil + 5 ml soap water per 15-liter pump.
Pseudomonas Bio-Fungicide / சூடோமோனாஸ்: Mix 75 grams per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 75 கிராம்).
Panchagavya Organic Spray / பஞ்சகாவ்யா இயற்கை உரம்: Mix 450 ml per 15-liter pump (3% solution).
preventive_measures: Treat seeds before sowing by soaking in hot water (50°C for 25 minutes) or Trichoderma suspension.
Follow a 2-year crop rotation without chillies, tomatoes, or brinjals.
Plant certified bacterial spot-resistant hybrid seeds.

Tomato___Early_blight.description: Characteristic dark brown circular spots with distinct concentric rings ('target board' pattern) bordered by yellow halos. Begins on older bottom leaves and spreads upward, causing severe leaf drying, stem collar rot, and sunscald on unprotected fruits.
cultural_controls: Prune off lower leaves touching the ground up to 1 foot height once plants establish.
Lay clean straw mulch (*வைக்கோல் மூடாக்கு*) or plastic mulch to stop rainwater splashing fungal soil spores onto lower foliage.
Stake tomato vines upright on bamboo poles (*மூங்கில் கம்பு கட்டுதல்*) for excellent air circulation.
Water exclusively at soil level using drip irrigation; keep foliage completely dry.
chemical_controls: Yellow Powder Fungicide / மஞ்சள் பொடி மருந்து - Dithane M-45 [Chemical: Mancozeb 75% WP]: The most popular yellow powder fungicide. Mix 2 tablespoons (35-40g) in a 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 35-40 கிராம்) at first spot on lower leaves.

White Shield Powder / வெள்ளை பாதுகாப்பு பொடி - Kavach 75% WP [Chemical: Chlorothalonil 75% WP]: Off-white protective powder. Mix 30 grams per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 30 கிராம்) for long-lasting canopy cover.

Curative Liquid / கருகல் நிவாரண திரவம் - Score 25% EC [Chemical: Difenoconazole 25% EC]: Small bottle liquid medicine. Take 8-10 ml per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 8-10 மி.லி) for rapid systemic curative healing.

Blue Packet Combo Fungicide / சாஃப் மருந்து - SAAF [Chemical: Carbendazim 12% + Mancozeb 63% WP]: The famous blue packet combo. Mix 30 grams per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 30 கிராம்).
Dual Action Curative - Amistar Top [Chemical: Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC]: Take 15 ml per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 15 மி.லி) during severe spreading blight.
biological_controls: Seedling Root Dip / நாற்று வேர் நனைத்தல்: Dip seedling roots in Trichoderma viride suspension (10g/L water) for 20 minutes before transplanting.
Sour Buttermilk Spray / புளித்த மோர் கரைசல்: Mix 750 ml sour buttermilk in a 15-liter pump (5% solution) as a protective bio-shield against fungal spores.
Neem Oil Spray / வேப்பெண்ணெய் கரைசல்: Mix 40 ml neem oil + 5 ml liquid soap per 15-liter pump.
Panchagavya Organic Spray / பஞ்சகாவ்யா இயற்கை உரம்: Mix 450 ml per 15-liter pump (3% solution) to strengthen natural plant immunity.
preventive_measures: Sow certified early blight-tolerant hybrid seeds (e.g. Arka Rakshak, Arka Samrat, Syngenta Abhinav).
Follow a 3-year crop rotation without potatoes, chillies, or eggplants.
Maintain clean field borders free of solanaceous weeds.

Tomato___Late_blight.description: Rapidly expanding water-soaked greasy greenish-black lesions on leaves and stems. White cottony mold appears on leaf undersides during cool, foggy, and humid weather. Can wipe out entire tomato fields within days and turns green tomatoes brown, greasy, and rotten.
cultural_controls: Open polyhouse and green net side curtains immediately to purge trapped humidity.
Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation; deliver water strictly at ground level through drip emitters.
Stake tomato vines upright and prune bottom side suckers (*பக்கக் கிளை கிள்ளுதல்*) for thorough airflow.
Uproot and bury infected plants immediately at the first sign of late blight.
chemical_controls: Late Blight Emergency Powder / அழுகல் நிவாரணி - Ridomil Gold [Chemical: Metalaxyl-M 4% + Mancozeb 64% WP]: Mix 2 tablespoons (35-40g) in a 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 35-40 கிராம்) at first symptom.

Yellow Powder Fungicide / மஞ்சள் பொடி மருந்து - Indofil M-45 or Dithane M-45 [Chemical: Mancozeb 75% WP]: Mix 35-40 grams per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 35-40 கிராம்) as preventive spray before fog or rain.
Epidemic Stop Medicine - Acrobat [Chemical: Dimethomorph 50% WP]: Take 15 grams per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 15 கிராம்) tank-mixed with Mancozeb (30g).
Systemic Oomycide - Revus [Chemical: Mandipropamid 23.4% SC]: Take 15 ml per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 15 மி.லி).
biological_controls: Blue Copper Powder / நீல மருந்து - Blitox 50 [Chemical: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP]: Mix 35-40 grams per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 35-40 கிராம்) before wet weather spells.
Trichoderma Soil Inoculation / ட்ரைக்கோடெர்மா: Mix 2.5 kg Trichoderma with 100 kg farmyard manure (தொழு உரம்) per acre during field preparation.
Panchagavya Organic Spray / பஞ்சகாவ்யா இயற்கை உரம்: Mix 450 ml per 15-liter pump (3% solution).
preventive_measures: Plant certified late blight-tolerant hybrids (e.g. Arka Abhed, Arka Rakshak, US-440).
Do not cultivate tomatoes adjacent to late blight-infected potato plots.
Monitor local weather alerts and spray preventive protectant before continuous cool rains.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.description: Pale yellow chlorotic spots form on upper surface of older leaves, matching olive-green to velvety brown mold patches on the underside. Highly prevalent in humid polyhouses, shaded net houses, and during extended monsoon fog.
cultural_controls: Open polyhouse and green shade net side curtains during the day to maximize natural cross ventilation.
Prune bottom suckers (*பக்கக் கிளை கிள்ளுதல்*) and lower yellowing leaves up to 1 foot above ground level.
Space tomato plants generously (60 cm x 50 cm) on raised beds; avoid overcrowding in polyhouses.
Water exclusively at soil level using drip tubes; keep foliage completely dry.

Panchagavya Organic Spray / பஞ்சகாவ்யா இயற்கை உரம்: Mix 450 ml per 15-liter pump (3% solution) to strengthen natural leaf immunity.

Wash and disinfect polyhouse plastic sheets, shade nets, and bamboo stakes with 1% bleaching powder between seasons.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.description: Leaves develop fine pale-yellow stippling and speckled bronze discoloration. Fine silky webbing covers leaf undersides and growing shoot tips. Under hot, dry weather, populations explode and scorch entire vines.
cultural_controls: Wash leaf undersides with a high-pressure jet of plain water in early morning to dislodge mites and destroy webs.
Eliminate dusty road dust by dampening farm paths; dust promotes heavy spider mite outbreaks.
Clear broadleaf weeds along field borders that host overwintering spider mites.

Blue Packet Combo Fungicide / சாஃப் மருந்து - SAAF [Chemical: Carbendazim 12% + Mancozeb 63% WP]: Mix 30 grams per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 30 கிராம்).

biological_controls: Sour Buttermilk Spray / புளித்த மோர் கரைசல்: Mix 750 ml sour buttermilk in a 15-liter pump (5% solution).
Neem Oil Spray / வேப்பெண்ணெய் கரைசல்: Mix 40 ml neem oil with soap water per 15-liter pump.
Panchagavya Organic Spray / பஞ்சகாவ்யா இயற்கை உரம்: Mix 450 ml per 15-liter pump (3% solution).
Trichoderma Bio-Fungicide / ட்ரைக்கோடெர்மா: Mix 75 grams per 15-liter pump.
preventive_measures: Practice a 3-year crop rotation without solanaceous crops.
Ensure wide plant spacing (60cm x 50cm) to keep air circulating freely.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.pathogen_type: Viral (Begomovirus, transmitted by Whitefly / Bemisia tabaci)
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.description: Leaves become markedly stunted, curled upward like cups, with prominent yellowing (chlorosis) along margins and interveinal areas. Plants become bushy and dwarfed; flowers drop without setting fruit, causing near-total yield failure.
cultural_controls: Install Yellow Sticky Traps / மஞ்சள் நிற ஒட்டும் பொறிகள்: Hang 12-15 yellow sticky traps per acre at canopy level to monitor and mass-trap whitefly vectors.
Eradicate and bag infected stunted plants immediately at first sighting; do not leave them in the field.
Grow 3-4 dense barrier rows of maize or sorghum (*மக்காச்சோளம் அல்லது சோளம் எல்லைப் பயிர்*) around tomato plots to block flying whiteflies.
Cover seedling nursery beds with 40-mesh insect-proof nylon net.
chemical_controls: Whitefly Pest Liquid / வெள்ளை ஈ மருந்து - Confidor [Chemical: Imidacloprid 17.8% SL]: Mix 5-7 ml in a 15-liter knapsack pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 5-7 மி.லி). Spray targeting leaf undersides where whiteflies feed.
Sucking Pest Medicine / சாறு உறிஞ்சும் பூச்சி மருந்து - Actara [Chemical: Thiamethoxam 25% WG]: Mix 1 teaspoon (5g) in a 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 5 கிராம்).
Whitefly Nymph Controller - Pegasus [Chemical: Diafenthiuron 50% WP]: Mix 15-20 grams per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 20 கிராம்).
biological_controls: Neem Oil Vector Spray / வேப்பெண்ணெய் கரைசல்: Mix 45-50 ml neem oil (10,000 ppm) + 5 ml soap water per 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 50 மி.லி). Repels whiteflies and disrupts egg laying.
Sour Buttermilk & Asafoetida Spray / புளித்த மோர் மற்றும் பெருங்காயக் கரைசல்: Mix 750 ml sour buttermilk + 10g hing in a 15-liter pump.
Panchagavya Organic Spray / பஞ்சகாவ்யா இயற்கை உரம்: Mix 450 ml per 15-liter pump (3% solution) to stimulate plant vigor.
preventive_measures: Plant certified TYLCV-resistant hybrid tomato varieties (e.g., US-440, Arka Rakshak, Arka Samrat, Syngenta Abhinav).
Drench nursery seedlings with Imidacloprid (0.5 ml/L) 3 days before field transplanting.

severity_actions.Moderate: Spray systemic insecticide Actara (5g per 15L pump); uproot and burn visibly stunted, curled virus-infected plants.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.pathogen_type: Viral (Tobamovirus, mechanically transmitted by hands, tools, and sap)
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.description: Leaves display alternating light-green and dark-green mosaic mottling, accompanied by leaf distortion, curling, and 'shoestring' narrowing of leaflets. Stems develop dark internal brown necrosis and fruit ripening becomes uneven with brown internal walls.
cultural_controls: Immediately uproot, bag, and burn plants showing mosaic mottling; do not compost virus-infected plants.
Wash hands with soap and water or 10% Trisodium Phosphate (TSP) before handling tomato plants.
Workers should never smoke, chew, or handle tobacco (*புகையிலை*) near tomato crops (tobacco carries mosaic virus).
Sanitize pruning knives and shears by dipping in 10% bleach solution between rows.
chemical_controls: No chemical viricides exist to cure viral plant infections. Focus on tool sanitation and vector control.

20% Skimmed Milk Protective Spray / பால் கரைசல் தெளிப்பு: Dissolve 3 liters fresh skimmed cow milk in a 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 3 லிட்டர் பால்). Spray onto foliage before pruning or staking; milk proteins coat and deactivate mechanically spread virus particles.
biological_controls: Sour Buttermilk & Asafoetida Spray / புளித்த மோர் மற்றும் பெருங்காயக் கரைசல்: Mix 750 ml sour buttermilk + 10g hing in a 15-liter pump.
Panchagavya Organic Spray / பஞ்சகாவ்யா இயற்கை உரம்: Mix 450 ml per 15-liter pump (3% solution) to build natural systemic resistance.
Neem Oil Preventive / வேப்பெண்ணெய் கரைசல்: Mix 40 ml neem oil with soap water per 15-liter pump to repel vector insects.
preventive_measures: Sow certified ToMV-resistant hybrid seeds (carrying Tm-2a resistance gene).
Heat-treat dry tomato seeds at 70°C for 3 days to eliminate seed-borne virus particles.
Control chewing and sap-sucking insects in the field.

severity_actions.Mild: Uproot and burn virus-infected plants; spray milk solution (3L milk in 15L pump) before handling healthy plants.
severity_actions.Moderate: Sanitize all stakes and tools with 10% bleach; immediately remove all mosaic-mottled plants; wash hands before handling crop.
severity_actions.Severe: Rogue out affected plants aggressively; spray milk solution across remaining crop; disinfect all nursery trays and stakes before next season.

fertilizers_and_nutrition: All 19 Foliar Tonic / 19:19:19 ஆல் 19 இலைவழி உரம்: Mix 75 grams in a 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 75 கிராம்) to assist healthy plants in sustaining vegetative vigor.

Tomato___healthy.description: Tomato plants are vigorous with deep green foliage, strong thick stems, abundant flower clusters, and zero disease lesions.
cultural_controls: Prune lower foliage touching the soil up to 1 foot above ground level once plants establish.
Stake tomato vines upright on bamboo poles (*மூங்கில் கம்பு கட்டுதல்*) or trellis wires to maximize sunlight and airflow.
Maintain clean straw mulch (*வைக்கோல் மூடாக்கு*) or plastic mulch to conserve root moisture and prevent weed competition.
Deliver irrigation consistently through drip emitters; avoid wetting foliage.
chemical_controls: No chemical fungicides or insecticides required. Maintain routine preventive monitoring.
biological_controls: Panchagavya Organic Spray / பஞ்சகாவ்யா இயற்கை உரம்: Mix 450 ml per 15-liter pump (3% solution) every 15 days to sustain robust plant immunity.
Neem Oil Preventive Spray / வேப்பெண்ணெய் கரைசல்: Mix 35 ml neem oil with soap water per 15-liter pump every 2 weeks as a natural pest deterrent.
Trichoderma Soil Drench / ட்ரைக்கோடெர்மா: Drench 50 grams per 15L pump around root zones once a month.
preventive_measures: Inspect leaf undersides weekly for early signs of whiteflies, leaf mold, or blight.
Keep field borders clean of solanaceous weeds.
Ensure uniform soil calcium and moisture to prevent blossom-end rot during peak fruit expansion.

severity_actions.Healthy: No intervention needed. Continue balanced fertigation, organic tonics, and vine staking.

fertilizers_and_nutrition: All 19 Foliar Tonic / 19:19:19 ஆல் 19 இலைவழி உரம்: Mix 75 grams in a 15-liter pump (15 லிட்டர் தெளிப்பான் பம்பிற்கு 75 கிராம்). Spray foliage every 12-14 days to sustain rapid growth.
Calcium Nitrate & Boron / கால்சியம் நைட்ரேட் மற்றும் போரான்: Mix 15g Calcium Nitrate + 5g Boron per 15-liter pump at flowering and fruit setting to stop blossom-end rot (*தக்காளி அழுகல் நோய்*).
Micronutrient Tonic / நுண்ணூட்டச் சத்து கரைசல்: Spray 20 grams per 15-liter pump (Zinc, Iron, Manganese, Magnesium) for vibrant green foliage.
Soil Health Booster / மட்கிய தொழு உரம்: Apply 2 kg well-rotted farmyard manure (தொழு உரம்) + 200g Vermicompost (மண்புழு உரம்) enriched with Trichoderma per plant.
